args.query:
-- Compute 90-day retention for cohorts of signups starting each week between 2026-04-13 and 2026-04-19 (one cohort week), by acquisition channel.
WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT u.user_id, u.user_channel, DATE(u.user_signup_date) AS signup_date
  FROM fct_users u
  WHERE DATE(u.user_signup_date) BETWEEN '2026-04-13' AND '2026-04-19'
    AND u.user_is_internal = False
),
cohort_activity AS (
  SELECT c.user_id, c.user_channel,
    c.signup_date,
    MIN(a.activity_active_date) AS first_activity_date,
    MAX(CASE WHEN DATE(a.activity_active_date) BETWEEN DATE(c.signup_date) + INTERVAL '90 day' AND DATE(c.signup_date) + INTERVAL '90 day' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_on_day90,
    MAX(CASE WHEN DATE(a.activity_active_date) BETWEEN DATE(c.signup_date) AND DATE(c.signup_date) + INTERVAL '90 day' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_within_90
  FROM cohort c
  LEFT JOIN fct_activity a
    ON a.activity_user_id = c.user_id
  GROUP BY c.user_id, c.user_channel, c.signup_date
)
SELECT ca.user_channel AS channel,
  COUNT(*) AS cohort_size,
  SUM(active_on_day90) AS retained_day90,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(active_within_90) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),4) AS pct_active_within_90
FROM cohort_activity ca
GROUP BY ca.user_channel
ORDER BY retained_day90 DESC;
